# Miuix

FusionStatusBar's settings pages use the published Miuix component library.

- Upstream: https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix
- Version: 0.8.8
- Maven coordinate: `top.yukonga.miuix.kmp:miuix:0.8.8`
- License: Apache-2.0, reproduced in [LICENSE](LICENSE).
- Integration: Kotlin/Compose settings controls, navigation, application lists, and window bottom sheets.

The library is consumed through Gradle; its implementation source is not copied into this project.
